description: Validate a dependency-ordered plan without starting jobs or consuming studio quota. Read capabilities_get first. Declare the dopamine hook(s) built into the final work as dopamine_hooks; a creative plan without one stays valid and returns a dopamine_hook_missing suggestion; explicit user overrides are allowed.

dopamine_hooks.description: Creative baseline: the dopamine hook(s) you built into the FINAL work. Declare at least one for any plan that creates image, voice, music, video or movie output, after reading dopamine_hooks_get. The server records each as a "[도파민 요소] …" line in goal, shown to the user on the dashboard.

channel.description: How the audience meets it: visual (시각), audio (음향) or situation (상황).

where.description: Where and how it appears in the finished work, in one line. Example: "0~3초: 오븐 문이 열리며 김이 오르는 빵 클로즈업".

goal.description: Desired finished deliverable and user-provided requirements.
goal.title: Goal

steps.description: Production steps in dependency order, with studio arguments and result bindings.
steps.title: Steps

title.description: Display title for the plan or movie.
title.title: Title
